# ABC News
> ABC News provides breaking news, live coverage, video, and reporting across U.S., world, politics, business, health, and entertainment.

ABC News is a national news platform featuring live streaming, on-demand video, topical coverage pages, and ongoing reporting on major current events. It organizes coverage by newsroom desks and programs, with dedicated sections for live updates, shows, and consumer content.

## Core News
- [ABC News Home](https://abcnews.com/): Homepage with top stories, breaking news, featured video, and live updates.
- [Live](https://abcnews.com/Live): 24/7 ABC News Live stream with breaking coverage and special events.
- [Video](https://abcnews.com/Video): News clips, interviews, explainers, and featured video segments.
- [Shows](https://abcnews.com/shows): Directory of ABC News programs, series, and show-related content.
- [Shop](https://abcnews.com/Shop): Shopping and product recommendation content from ABC News.
- [ABC News on Disney+](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-7c160b55-f261-476a-b3f7-f3a6b083cba2?cid=DTCI-Site-ABCNews-Site-Awareness-DisneyPlus-US-DisneyPlus-NA-EN-NavLink-NA-NA): Streaming destination for ABC News content on Disney+.

## U.S. News
- [U.S.](https://abcnews.com/US): National news coverage including crime, courts, weather, and major domestic stories.
- [Crime](https://abcnews.com/US): U.S. reporting often includes crime, law enforcement, and justice coverage.
- [Weather](https://abcnews.com/US): National weather-related reporting and severe event coverage within U.S. news.
- [Investigations](https://abcnews.com/US): In-depth domestic reporting and accountability stories in the U.S. section.

## Politics
- [Politics](https://abcnews.com/Politics): Coverage of elections, Congress, the White House, policy, and campaigns.
- [Congress](https://abcnews.com/Politics): Reporting on legislation, votes, hearings, and leadership developments.
- [White House](https://abcnews.com/Politics): Coverage of the presidency, administration actions, and executive policy.
- [Elections](https://abcnews.com/Politics): Election news, campaign developments, and voting-related reporting.

## World
- [International](https://abcnews.com/International): Global reporting on conflicts, diplomacy, and major world developments.
- [Live Updates](https://abcnews.com/International/live-updates/iran-live-updates-trumps-48-hour-deadline-expire/?id=131316431): Live blog tracking developments in the Iran conflict and U.S. response.
- [Middle East Coverage](https://abcnews.com/International): International reporting includes Middle East conflict and diplomacy coverage.
- [Global Affairs](https://abcnews.com/International): World news on international politics, security, and humanitarian crises.

## Business
- [Business](https://abcnews.com/Business): Business, markets, economy, personal finance, and consumer news coverage.
- [Economy](https://abcnews.com/Business): Reporting on inflation, jobs, growth, and broader economic trends.
- [Markets](https://abcnews.com/Business): Coverage of stocks, companies, and financial market developments.
- [Personal Finance](https://abcnews.com/Business): Consumer-focused money news and practical financial reporting.

## Health
- [Health](https://abcnews.com/Health): Medical news, public health reporting, wellness, and health policy coverage.
- [Public Health](https://abcnews.com/Health): Coverage of health systems, disease trends, and public health issues.
- [Medical Research](https://abcnews.com/Health): Reporting on studies, treatments, and scientific health developments.
- [Wellness](https://abcnews.com/Health): Consumer health, lifestyle, and wellness-focused reporting.

## Entertainment & Culture
- [Entertainment](https://abcnews.com/Entertainment): Entertainment news, celebrity coverage, and culture reporting.
- [Shows](https://abcnews.com/shows): Program hub for ABC News shows and recurring series.
- [What You Need to Know on Disney+](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-c99a2244-2ec4-449a-9dde-8b09a408f923?cid=DTCI-Site-ABCNews-Site-Awareness-DisneyPlus-US-DisneyPlus-NA-EN-NavLink-NA-NA): Streaming page for the ABC News program "What You Need to Know."
- [Video Features](https://abcnews.com/Video): Entertainment interviews, feature packages, and culture-related video segments.

## Live Updates & Developing Stories
- [Iran Live Updates](https://abcnews.com/International/live-updates/iran-live-updates-trumps-48-hour-deadline-expire/?id=131316431): Ongoing live coverage page for a major international developing story.
- [Trump Signature on Currency](https://abcnews.com/Politics/trumps-signature-added-us-currency-treasury/story?id=131451419): Politics story covering Treasury and U.S. currency-related reporting.
- [Epstein Probe](https://abcnews.com/US/house-oversight-panel-seeks-testimony-private-investigators-removed/story?id=131446031): U.S. story on congressional oversight and the Epstein-related investigation.
- [Youth Gambling](https://abcnews.com/US/public-health-crisis-experts-weigh-stakes-youth-gambling/story?id=131328317): U.S. feature on youth gambling as a public health concern.
- [Election Records Case](https://abcnews.com/US/trump-administration-face-questions-seizure-fulton-county-2020/story?id=131447627): U.S. legal and political reporting on election records and federal scrutiny.
